title: Slide frontmatter
description: Flat frontmatter of a slide instance at presentations/<slug>/slides/S##-<archetype>.md (forks add .v<n>). Body sections: ## Elements, ## Notes, ## Redlines.
$comment: A fork is a Slide with parent set and version > 1; PLAN Skill 3 calls it status: candidate, which this schema expresses as parent != "-" with fill_status auto or edited.

slide_no.description: Position in the deck. Canva caps a design at 350 pages.

deck.description: Deck slug; the presentations/<slug> directory name.

units.description: Content unit ids bound into this slide, in binding order.

fill_status.$comment: Closed enum. Source of truth: spec/vocab/status.json. JSON Schema cannot load the vocab at runtime, so validate.mjs injects the enum from that file; keep this array in sync with it.
fill_status.description: How the copy got here. Subset of spec/vocab/status.json with broader slide_status.

overflow.description: True when any element text exceeds its maxChars. Must be false before upload.

redline_status.$comment: Closed enum. Source of truth: spec/vocab/status.json. JSON Schema cannot load the vocab at runtime, so validate.mjs injects the enum from that file; keep this array in sync with it.
redline_status.description: State of synced Canva comment threads. Subset with broader redline_status.

canva_page_id.description: Canva page id for this slide. Quoted string so PowerShell never coerces it to Int64 (research/06 §e). "-" when not uploaded.

locators.description: Per-element Canva locator ids in element-table order.

canva_ops.description: Path to this slide generated ops file under build/canva-ops/. Repo-relative POSIX path, or "-" when not set.

brand.$comment: Closed enum. Source of truth: spec/vocab/brand.json. JSON Schema cannot load the vocab at runtime, so validate.mjs injects the enum from that file; keep this array in sync with it.
brand.description: Inherited from the deck brief; may differ from the layout when a neutral layout is branded at fill time.

pairing.description: Named pairing in force for this slide.

fonts_native.description: True when every family on this slide is Canva-native.

parent.description: Redline fork lineage: the slide filename this file was forked from, or "-" for a canonical slide.

version.description: Fork version. 1 for a canonical slide; a fork written by slide-redline increments it.

change_request.description: The operator plain-language request, stored verbatim on a fork. "-" on a canonical slide.

changed_keys.description: Frontmatter keys and element-table cells the fork changed, as key or n.column. Must exactly explain the before/after pixel diff.
